description: [1/5] Research the whole AegeanWorks profile, select a unique Rust programmer tool (FSM verification, replay, golden traces), record ADR-001 and the architecture

impact_assessment.why: The portfolio has no state-machine verification or stateful-regression tool; programmers building event-driven systems need deterministic replay and trace diffing, and the directive makes explicit state machines a first-class constraint.
impact_assessment.benefits: A unique Rust-only tool for the studio; a design where the product itself demonstrates the three architectural principles; deterministic, inspectable traces that fit the studio's local-first philosophy.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: DSL grammar and trace format must stay stable for golden files; dependency: only Rust std is available offline; concurrency: none, single-process CLI; state: replay must be a pure function of (machine, events) so traces are reproducible.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Freeze a versioned trace header in ADR-001-era design notes, use no external crates, keep core I/O-free with a source-scanning test, and derive all state through explicit enum transitions with golden determinism tests.

description: [2/5] Implement the pure functional core: model, parser, transition engine, verifier, bounded explorer, seeded PRNG and deterministic trace formatting
[3/5] Implement the imperative shell: CLI parsing, isolated I/O edge, explicit SessionState transition table, command orchestration and exit codes
[4/5] Add examples and golden fixture, DSL/ARCHITECTURE/AUDIT docs, README, and a Rust inventory subcommand so the AIKit compat gate is satisfied without Python
[5/5] Phase 4 passed: 24 Rust tests green and all five project gates (hygiene, guidelines, secrets, compat, test) passed
Complete the README tracked-path inventory (cargo dir and mod.rs files) after the delivery commit
[1/5] Plan v0.2: coverage analysis, deterministic failing-input minimization and FSM graph export

impact_assessment.why: A verifier that only answers pass/fail leaves programmers blind to untested edges, unable to shrink a failing repro, and without a visual model; these are the next highest-value needs and are pure functions of the existing data.
impact_assessment.benefits: Actionable coverage percentages, a minimal reproducer for a failing invariant, and reviewable DOT/Mermaid diagrams; all three deepen the functional core without new dependencies.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new text output formats must be versioned and deterministic; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: the minimizer needs its own explicit state machine and must terminate on every input.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Versioned output headers, sorted iteration, a closed MinimizerState transition table tested exhaustively, and a documented 1-minimality guarantee with bounded replay counts.
